Stacking more and more masses will eventually make it unstable in any engine that solves for contacts iteratively using floating point numbers. Even offline ones, and especially real-time/game engines. It's all about tradeoffs.

title: Alpha 4.10.2 - RSI Discovery Month
summary: Hi everyone,
body_html:
Hi everyone,

RSI is celebrating the arrival of the next-generation Constellation, the new Mk V Centaurus, and all pilots across Stanton are invited to join in. Special RSI installations have been set up throughout the Stanton system, honoring the legendary history of the Constellation Mk IV and introducing the new Mk V and its companion, the Skylark.

However you would like to take part, there's a role for you. Defend fellow pilots from the criminals drawn to the valuable ships and cargo surrounding the event, keep vital supplies moving across Stanton, or collect industrial materials and lost cargo. Every mission moves you closer to RSI-themed rewards across four tracks in your mobiGlas. Ship paints, flight blades, components, armor, and weapons are all up for grabs.

Best of all, every pilot who completes the Constellation Rental Offer gets five days of special rental access to the Constellation Mk V Centaurus and the Skylark. Don't miss your chance to see why this new generation is destined to become as legendary as the rest.

Beyond RSI Discovery Month, Alpha 4.10.2 also brings more updates. All RSI Constellation Mk IV variants receive their Gold Standard update, and the physics networking overhaul improves how physics are handled across the 'verse. Alongside these updates, a range of bug fixes continue to improve the Live experience and keep your journey smooth from launch to landing.

title: Re: VR hardware
summary: This is a question you have to answer for yourself, as it depends on a few factors:
body_html:
This is a question you have to answer for yourself, as it depends on a few factors:

- Are you just going to play Star Citizen or any other games?

- Do you prefer a wireless or wired Headset?

- Is OLED Important to you (true blacks)

- Comfort?

- What is your budget? What GPU do you have?

If you have a Quest 2 any modern headset right now will be a serious improvement, even if it just a Quest 3.

The perfect headset in my mind would still be a OLED Steam Frame with high resolutions. Still praying we get that one day. I know there are rumours, but I don't expect it any time soon.

Overall the Steam Frame runs and works well with Star Citizen, but visually it is not better as the Quest 3, maybe even slightly worse. It is much more comfortable than the Quest 3 and everything just works.

If you have a capable GPU and the budget Dream Air is the best you can get right now. Also very comfortable and visually seriously impressive.

title: 2026 Pumpkin Decorating Contest
summary: Update:
body_html:
Update:

The submission period for the 2026 Pumpkin Decorating Contest has ended. Thank you for all the spooky and creative pumpkins! Next, the CIG judges will review all submissions and select the winners from all three categories. "The Hill Horror" Helmet will be sent to all qualified entries once the review is finished. Stay tuned for more updates!

_________________

Ghostly greetings, y'all!

Shadows are stretching longer, and there's a chill creeping into the air, which can only mean one thing: Day of the Vara is here, and it's time to dust off the carving knives. We're bringing back one of our favorite community traditions: the Pumpkin Decorating Contest!

Grab a pumpkin, your carving knife, your paintbrush, or whatever else you've got in the toolshed, and turn your gourd into the spookiest creation this side of the 'verse. This year, we're leaning into some classic monster themes: Frankenstein, Vampire, and Werewolf. As a treat and not a trick, every qualified entry earns "The Hill Horror" Helmet that's permanently attributed to your account, one per account. So pick your poison and show us what you've got for a shot at some devilishly good prizes.

Welcome to the '2026 Pumpkin Decorating Contest!

Before You Begin

:exclamation:Before you start on your submissions, please read the contest rules carefully and remember to post your entries to the Day of the Vara 2956 event page on the Community Hub. Replies to this thread will NOT count as entries.:exclamation:

Keep In Mind

Read the contest rules! :book:

Your pumpkin must fit one of the three monster themes: Frankenstein, Vampire, or Werewolf. Bonus points for weaving in Star Citizen: ship silhouettes, faction logos, alien flavor, scenes from the 'verse. The more SC flavor, the better your shot at winning, but a solid monster pumpkin on its own still counts.

Your submission must also include at least one photo or video that shows your process. Your submission will NOT be accepted without this.

Only real pumpkins, carved and/or painted, will be accepted

Submit your posts carefully, as posts edited after the submission deadline will not be considered. If you have made an error in the post, you can edit it provided this is done within the official duration of the contest.

Please post your submissions to the Day of the Vara 2956 event page on the Community Hub.

Each unique pumpkin is considered a single entry, and you are allowed multiple entries, but you can only win 1 prize.

No image post-processing, special or after-effects of any kind may be applied or performed on the photograph to create any submission, although the pumpkin may be photographed with decoration, arrangement, or lighting.

Submissions that use or feature AI will NOT be considered.

Any submission not following the above instructions will NOT be considered.

Any submission that meets the above requirements will be awarded "The Hill Horror" Helmet to be attributed after the contest ends.

Winning Conditions

The CIG jury will judge your submissions on:

Quality: Clean carving or paint work that holds up in a photo. A Frankenstein stitched together with sloppy cuts and slapped-on paint won't score as well as one built with real care.

Creativity: A carved Werewolf could just be a wolf face. An SC spin might have it howling at a Crusader moon. Both qualify. The second just scores higher.

Rule adherence: Even the scariest Vampire won't score if it skips the contest requirements. Read the rules, follow them, and you're covered.

Dates

The submission period will end on Monday, November 9, 2026, 20:00 UTC.

Prizes

One winner from each theme/category will receive their choice of one of three ships with LTI (in-game lifetime insurance) + accompanying paint + one mask bundle. These prizes are non-giftable and non-upgradable.

Drake Vulture in-game ship with LTI (in-game lifetime insurance) + Frankenstein paint + Mask bundle.

Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf in-game ship with LTI (in-game lifetime insurance) + Werewolf paint + Mask bundle.

Aegis Eclipse in-game ship with LTI (in-game lifetime insurance) + Vampire paint + Mask bundle.

Time to squash the competition with your spooktacular handiwork; we can't wait to see what you come up with! :jack_o_lantern:

Design Notes from Zac

It's been a while since the Lightning Bolt Co. has unleashed a weapon onto the verse but with this new fully automatic DMR, they're here to make an impression.

The Skarnov rifle, like the other LBCO weapons leaves the target with an electrified pulse that denotates and chains to other nearby targets causing devastation for enemies in tight proximity.

It's got a really consistent but high vertical recoil profile allowing skills operators to shut down highly armoured enemies easily but as an energy weapon the danger of over heating is present.

The skarnov is effected by the atmospheric temperatures its used in, causing hot environments to cause overheat faster and colder environments to build up heat slower.

title: Re: Star Citizen VR Support - Experimental Release (Alpha 4.8/4.9/4.10)
summary: Hello Citizens, a few tweaks and fixes have been made to the new zoom for the latest patch.
body_html:
Hello Citizens, a few tweaks and fixes have been made to the new zoom for the latest patch.

Alpha 4.10.3: VR Updates (EDIT: Will come with the next patch)

- Third-person cameras no longer zoom the VR view when the gameplay FOV changes. Ship ADS no longer zooms the ship's third-person view.

- Added scope eye relief. While a scope zooms the VR view, the view now moves back along the scope so more of the magnified image stays visible. The pull-back scales with scope zoom up to a maximum (none at 1x, 9 cm at 4x, 15 cm at 6x and above). It adjusts smoothly when you switch zoom levels and fades in and out with the zoom. Vehicle ADS and Interaction Mode zooms are unaffected.

- Split the VR zoom strength setting into separate Scope Zoom Strength and Ship Zoom Strength sliders. These replace the previous Gameplay Zoom Strength setting. The zoom strength settings no longer affect the Interaction Mode zoom.

- Default tuning changes: minimum scope zoom raised from 1.0 to 1.6, scope align distance raised from 0.04 to 0.05, and zoom smoothing shortened from 0.2 to 0.15 for snappier transitions.

- Medbeds now default your VR view to looking up instead of forward at your body, which makes the screen easier to use without breaking your neck!

- Fixed texture banding on the scope projection texture.

- Fixed several crashes with the experimental VR depth composition option (r_StereoDepthComposition). Note that this is disabled by default and need to be explicitly enabled via console or user.cfg. Once enabled it keeps its value over subsequent runs.

title: Updates to Pledge Gifting - FAQ
summary: Hey y'all
body_html:
Hey y'all

Since the recent announcement about Updates to Pledge Gifting and Game Access, we’ve received a number of questions from the community. Much like in our previous Updates to Game Access - FAQ, we’ve gathered some of your most common questions below and clarified the details where needed.

When does this take effect?

The updates to gifting will take effect on October 30.

Can I gift anything?

Only items where the "Buying as a gift?" option appears at checkout.

How will the updated gifting process work?

When an item is gifted, the recipient will receive an email with a redemption code. They can select the redemption link (the code is filled in) or go to the Redemption Page and enter the code to claim their gift.

Does the recipient need an RSI account?

Yes. They’ll need an RSI account with a confirmed email address to claim the gift. An account can be created after receiving the gift email, before claiming the gift.

Can I gift an item if I am not signed in?

No. You must be signed in to gift or claim an item.

Can I pay for a gift with store credit?

No. Store credit can't be used on a gift order.

Will the gift appear in my Hangar before sending the gift?

No. The gift is emailed to the recipient after the transaction is completed and is added to the recipient's hangar when they claim it.

Do I get badges, perks, or referral credit for something I gifted?

The badges and perks go to the recipient who claims the gift. Referral credit for the purchase stays with the buyer.

How does the 30-day refund period work for a pledge designated as a gift?

If the gift isn't claimed after 30 days, the buyer is refunded automatically and notified by email.

What happens to existing hangar gifts?

Existing hangar gifts and gift codes are grandfathered in and will continue working just as they do today, with the same Redemption Page available to redeem them.

Do I have to give the gift right away or can I wait to send it to the recipient?

Gifts are sent automatically once the transaction is complete and cannot be scheduled for a later date.

title: RSI Launcher 2.19.2 Release Notes
summary: Hello everyone,
body_html:
Hello everyone,

Today, November 9th, we are releasing the RSI Launcher 2.19.2.

RSI Launcher can be found here:

https://install.robertsspaceindustries.com/rel/2/RSI%20Launcher-Setup-2.19.2.exe

This Thread was updated from Launcher 2.19.1 to 2.19.2 on November 9th. There is no major update in content, but a backend QOL fix.

In this version, we’ve updated the display of the download process to better indicate the status of the download phases and how many remain.

We’ve also added a shader compiling stage, so that this task can be done before entering the game.

The shader compiling feature is only fully working with game version 4.10.3 and up. Until then the game might still complie shaders while getting in the game.

:gear: New features:

What's new in this release:

New downloads panel: the header popover now shows the ongoing installation (version/channel, step-by-step progress, pause/resume/cancel, network, disk, CPU and memory usage).

The game page also shows a compact step row and progress bar under the game button.

Shader compilation (optional step): at the end of an install or update, the game can now compile its shader cache before entering the game. You can launch the game at any time, or choose “Skip shader compilation”: the install completes and the game finishes its shaders on the next launch.

New Settings for deleting and compiling shaders from the games settings.

The compiling phase can take from 7 to 30+ min depending on your computer.

Updated data patcher for data generations: smoother progress reporting, a verification pass that repeats until the files are clean, more detailed error information, and a dedicated dialog when the disk fills up during a download.

Guide System: Presence status in the account panel and in the guide session is in sync with the web

:wrench: Fixed Issues:

Downloads panel only redraws the values that change, reducing UI load during installs.

Fixed the Launcher muting and minimizing before showing the “already running” message on a double click launch.

:bug: Known issues:

title: Roadmap Roundup - November 4, 2026
summary: Hello everyone!
body_html:
Hello everyone!

Every two weeks, we accompany the Roadmap update with a brief explanatory note to give you insight into the decision-making that led to any changes. This is part of an effort to make our communications more transparent, more specific, and more insightful for all of you who help to make Star Citizen and Squadron 42 possible.

Just a reminder: The 1.0 column showcases features and content planned for inclusion in or before Star Citizen 1.0. This means you may not have to wait for the 1.0 release to experience them. As features/content in the 1.0 column become ready, they will migrate left into a point patch column for release.

Be sure to check back every two weeks for the latest updates.

-CIG Community Team

Notable Changes: November 4, 2026

With today's Roadmap Update, we're officially renaming Alpha 4.11 to Alpha 5.0, reflecting the significance of the new technologies and features coming together in this release.

At the heart of Alpha 5.0 are several foundational technologies from Genesis, our initiative to transform how we create, populate, and bring planetary environments to life.

Starchitect introduces a procedural world-building system that uses Genesis data to distribute locations across planetary surfaces and assemble them from modular components, allowing our teams to expand the universe at scale.

Planet Tech V5 overhauls how planets are generated and rendered, introducing more natural biomes, improved vegetation and rock distribution, enhanced terrain materials, and GPU-driven generation for richer environments and improved performance.

Population Manager introduces new systems for balancing server populations and populating environments with inhabitants suited to their surroundings, laying the groundwork for more dynamic interactions.

Contract Boards bring mission opportunities directly into the world. Guild Halls at regional hubs allow players to browse contracts, complete assignments, and build reputation with different guilds, while Contract Boards offer faction and guild missions at local, regional, global, and solar system levels. Featuring a brand-new interface with improved contract information and faction-based browsing, Contract Boards support our broader vision for Hub and Spoke gameplay.

DGS Planet Subdivision advances server meshing by dividing planets and moons into smaller, dynamically assigned server territories, rather than relying on a single server for an entire planetary body.

Nyx I will be the first planet to feature these technologies, with plans to expand them to Nyx II, Nyx III, and other existing locations and planets throughout the 'verse.

Together, these additions lay the foundation for more detailed environments, more dynamic planetary populations, and a universe that continues to grow in both scale and complexity.

We can't wait for you to explore Nyx I and experience what's coming in Alpha 5.0. With that, let's dive into this week's Roadmap Roundup!

Release View

Alpha 4.10

Lightning Bolt Company "Skarnov" DMR (4.10.3)

⁠Implementing the Lightning Bolt Company "Skarnov" DMR, a fully automatic designated marksman rifle whose specialized projectiles create electrical discharges between multiple targets, making it highly effective against groups of hostiles.

:scroll: This card is moving forward from 5.0, to release earlier in 4.10, and set to Committed.

Alpha 5.0

Item Recovery: Ship Loadout Improvements

Implementing Item Recovery: Ship Loadout Improvements, updating ship and item recovery to better support custom loadouts through timed claims, optional expedite fees, freight elevator item claims, and debuting a free recovery option when losses are detected as outside the player’s control.

:scroll: This Tentative card requires additional work and has been removed from the Release View for now.

Contract Boards

Implementing Contract Boards as a new way to discover and accept faction and guild missions at local, regional, global, and solar system levels through Guild Halls and hubs across the 'verse, featuring a brand-new interface that makes browsing contracts and filtering by faction easier and more intuitive.

:scroll: This card has been added and set to Committed.

S3 & S10 Bomb Racks

Implementing Size 10 and Size 3 bomb racks at shops in the PU, expanding support for different bomb sizes and loadout configurations.

:scroll: This card has been added and set to Committed.

Loot Refresh

Rebalancing loot at various sandbox locations and introducing previously Wikelo-exclusive rewards to the loot pool.

:scroll: This card has been added and set to Tentative.

Vehicle Combat Balance Pass

Implementing a weapon balancing pass for ship combat, with a focus on fighter combat and adjustments to weapon performance, time to kill, and the balance between energy and ballistic weapons.

:scroll: This card has been added and set to Tentative.

Kastak Arms "Hellion" Pistol

Implementing the Hellion Plasma Pistol, a high-velocity plasma weapon that creates hazardous impact zones, allowing operators to rapidly deploy multiple areas of denial across the battlefield.

:scroll: This card has been set to Committed.

Kastak Arms "Verdict" LMG

Implementing the Kastak Arms "Verdict" LMG, a medium-range weapon that builds heat through sustained fire before unleashing devastating superheated plasma projectiles with its alternate fire mode.

:scroll: This card has been set to Committed.

Alpha 5.1

Nyx II and Nyx III

:scroll: Previously targeting Alpha 5.0, these are now tentatively scheduled for Alpha 5.1.

title: [5.0 PTU Feedback] Starchitect POIs
summary: Greetings!
body_html:
Greetings!

Nyx I has been populated with points of interest (POIs) using the Starchitect tool, which is a new technology that dynamically scatters content across a planetary scale to flesh out an entire world with places to explore. This pre-export tool is used by designers to generate the following hierarchy of items:

Nyx I (Planet) > Sectors (Like a country) > Clusters (Like a region) > Locations (A POI) > Tiles (Buildings, OC’s etc).

Each part of this hierarchy has been given their own properties, data and rules to define their identity, allowing us to make sure that every part of the planet feels unique. Every cluster in a sector has a singular Hub location which is visible on the Starmap, along with it’s amenities. The rest is found by exploration or by engaging in contracts.

A feedback survey is available at: Starchitect POIs Survey Form. This survey will be open until Nov 30.

Thank you for taking the time, and we look forward to reading your feedback!

-Shark

title: [5.0 PTU Feedback] Intraplanetary Server Meshing
summary: Greetings!
body_html:
Greetings!

Today's Tech Preview takes the server meshing of Nyx I one step further. Nyx 1 uses the same Quasi-Dynamic Server Meshing (QDSM) algorithms introduced in 4.10 (to load-balance the many SoO instances onto different servers), to distribute Nyx I’s many many clusters onto different servers. This latest approach works with much smaller units and can therefore load balance more finely, putting more clusters on colder servers, and fewer clusters on hotter ones.

title: [Now Closed] Star Citizen Alpha 5.0 PTU 13119881 - Genesis, QDSM, Starchitect, Mission Boards
summary: Build: 13119881 - PTU Channel
body_html:
Build: 13119881 - PTU Channel

Wave 1 testers

Timeframe for test: Overnight until 2pm Central 20:00 UTC Friday

Welcome to the first 5.0 PTU! Across our recent Tech Previews we brought new location archetypes to Nyx I, introduced Intraplanetary Server Meshing, and added the Procedural Generation Tracker so that mineables, harvestables and fauna could run across the mesh. With this build we move into PTU proper. The focus this time is the planet itself: Nyx I has had a substantial environment pass covering biomes, flora placement, weather and lighting, alongside new guild halls with mission boards and another round of contract work.

Nyx I Environment Pass

The surface of Nyx I has had a broad polish pass this cycle, concentrating on how the biomes read at both close range and distance. Flora placement rules have been tightened so species no longer appear on ground types they have no business growing in, and the color work has been reconciled between near and far viewing distances so a forest looks the same whether you are standing in it or flying over it. We have also reworked how rock surfaces and medium terrain layers render, which should give geology considerably more depth than it had previously.

Forest density updated, with Heart of Woods now spawning in different locations

Gutierrezia and green Heart of Woods no longer spawn on beach soil, matching the other land plants

Mature Populus now receives random yaw and tilt instead of a fixed orientation

Summer foliage darkened, with far-distance color tuning to match close-up color

Lemna seasonal offset corrected so near and far colors agree

Snow biome accumulation now uses the same surface grouping as the other biomes

Clay and granite colors corrected, having previously been derived from the wrong color space

Rock shading classes now support parallax occlusion mapping, with height reworked to suit

Medium terrain layers now scaled for maximum precision against texture range

Bush shading class tweaks, and new shading classes for Nyx I

The environment team updated rock and environmental assets with explicit wheeled collision behavior setup per sub-asset following a drivability review

Several Nyx I rock variants now ignore wheeled vehicles entirely

Dalbergia physical collision restored after being lost in an earlier change

Potential Fix: Ground cover floating above the terrain, which now takes the lower of bedrock displacement and soil (STARC-221075)

Weather and Atmosphere

Atmospheric lighting has been reworked so that sky illumination responds to actual cloud cover rather than cloud type. Overcast skies now carry the light that genuinely scatters through a thick layer, which means brighter conditions beneath heavy cloud and a noticeably brighter night sky when it is overcast. Rain, lightning and the day-night temperature range now all follow real coverage too, and the snow effects have been retuned for the elevations Nyx I actually has.

Ground storm snow effects reworked, with the elevation ruleset changed so the main effects appear at the higher altitudes needed for Nyx I

Rain no longer accumulates below the snow line

Lightning strength calculation reworked, separating event location weighting from event strength

Lightning strikes are now more likely in lower density cloud clusters

Potential Fix: Lightning strikes culling too quickly on planets, with spawn shapes now sized to the targeting mode and strike frequency recalculated on each attempt

Planet audio queries now batch surface data lookups

Nyx I color grades and far-distance lookup tables updated

Guild Halls and Mission Boards

Guild halls have arrived on Nyx I, giving each guild a physical presence on the planet where contracts can be picked up from mission boards. Alongside these, the wider location kit has had an art and lighting pass, and loot distribution across settlements has been rebalanced following director feedback.

Guild hall walls, colors and room tinting reworked, with mesh pieces swapped to give logos breathing room and gloss reduced

Guild hall screen materials and cover window geometry added

Mission board and notice board backdrops added

Command and bridge buildings reworked, including floor heights, ceiling heights and visarea cleanup

New depot, campsite and bunker tiles, with loot added throughout

Loot quantity and quality increased in locked command building rooms

Sniper weapon racks and ammunition loot boxes added to watchtowers, with more ammunition caches across compound tiles

Logistics exterior cladding, wall kits and window frames refined

Watchtower and storage exterior fixes, plus a new vent prefab

Climbable ledges added across depot tiles, agriculture tiles and extractor sites

Placeholder ladders replaced with finished prefabs

Irrigator and extractor visual effects added

Lighting passes across habitation, storage, depot, agriculture, extraction, maintenance and watchtower tiles

Defensive turret health increased by 50% at sizes 1 through 3

Mining extractor kill volumes set up

Level 3 keycard NPCs removed from all combatant class pools except First Legion

Potential Fix: Shelf top item ports taking 1 SCU containers where they should take two-handed items

Potential Fix: Missing ceiling in an exterior alcove, inner railings around AA turrets, a replace-me decal, and a misaligned door interaction point

Contracts

Contract work continues across the guilds, with the Covalex sets coming online this cycle alongside campsite and missing person work. A number of generation and spawning problems that blocked contracts in the last preview have also been addressed.

Covalex contracts enabled, with a first pass on reward balance

Campsite contracts enabled, including the Hockrow missing person campsite

Eckhart Global contract fixes

Missing person mission hooks restored

Ship graveyard mission locations added around Nyx I

Contract titles and descriptions updated across the Nyx I set

Eliminate and Destroy contracts now share a resource slot with interior Eliminate Specifics

Espionage and diagnostics data disks are no longer stackable

Potential Fix: Red Wind lost shipment recovery contracts not appearing in game

Potential Fix: Eckhart Security target AI not spawning

Potential Fix: Missing person corpse not spawning

Potential Fix: Harvestable mission items being rejected by freight elevators

Potential Fix: Contracts requiring too many resource slots across multiple phases

Potential Fix: Eliminate All objectives at multi-location contracts

Potential Fix: Server rack entity tags for destroy server contracts

Potential Fix: “Opening” text wrapping incorrectly

Intraplanetary Server Meshing

Following the introduction of Intraplanetary Server Meshing and the Procedural Generation Tracker in the Tech Previews, this build focuses on the spatial systems underneath it. The entity tracking structures that decide what gets streamed, replicated and simulated have been substantially reworked for planetary scale, and the declaration ceiling for location entities has been raised to cope with the density of procedural surface content.

Spatial partitioning rework across entity streaming, the aggregate manager and network replication

Maximum location entity declarations raised to 256

Fleet service can now mark an unhealthy instance, and provisioned mesh instances can be queried directly

AI can once again use cover on planetary surfaces

title: IAE 2956 - Choose Your Adventure - FAQ
summary: Hey y'all,
body_html:
Hey y'all,

It’s time again for the Intergalactic Aerospace Expo 2956 to bring together the best that Human and Alien ingenuity has to offer in the ultimate ship showcase! To make sure you don’t miss out, we’ve pulled together answers to the questions we hear most.

What is the IAE?

The Intergalactic Aerospace Exposition (IAE) is the universe's premier aerospace expo. It's where everyone can see some of Star Citizen's most legendary ships and ground vehicles up close as different manufacturers showcase their latest and greatest in the expo center halls. More than 200 ships and ground vehicles are yours to test-fly for free! Whether you're a seasoned pilot or just starting your journey, this is your chance to take the helm of the universe's most iconic rides.

When is IAE taking place?

IAE runs from November 13 at 16:00 UTC through November 27.

When does the Free Fly start?

The Free Fly will start on November 13, simultaneously with the launch of IAE.

I don't have a Star Citizen game package or in-game spacecraft. How do I travel to New Babbage for the event?

For the duration of the IAE, every account has access to an RSI Aurora Mk II. After getting started, head to the nearest ASOP ship retrieval terminal to access it.

Where does the IAE take place? Where do I have to go?

IAE is being held at the Tobin Expo Center in New Babbage, the largest city on microTech.

How do I get to the Tobin Expo Center?

Start off by heading to microTech. After you create your character, you'll be asked where to start. Pick the Stanton system, then New Babbage as your primary residence, and your journey to the expo begins. Once there, follow the signs, hop on the Metroloop, and you’ll be in ship heaven in no time.

If you’re coming from off-planet, New Babbage’s spaceport is microTech’s main travel hub. Land there and follow the IAE signs for easy transport to the expo.

What ships are available to fly for free?

Each day of the IAE, there will be different ships available for you to test-fly. Check out the full Manufacturer Schedule for details.

How do I rent a ship?

In the expo center halls, you'll find ships on display from a variety of manufacturers throughout the event. If something catches your eye, head over to the Traveler Rentals terminals in the main IAE hall during that vehicle’s Manufacturer Day and follow the on-screen prompts to take it for a spin.

In addition to the ships on the show floor, each Manufacturer Day also unlocks a wider selection of flyable ships, some of which aren't on display but are still available to rent through the terminals. Manufacturers cycle almost every day, so be sure to check back often! You can visit the full schedule to plan your test flights.

You can then head to the spaceport or any other ASOP terminal throughout the 'verse.

How long can ships be rented?

Once you have rented a ship or vehicle, it will be available for 48 hours.

How many vehicles can be rented?

You can rent every flyable or drivable vehicle exhibited at the IAE, and some that aren’t exhibited, too. Each ship or vehicle can be rented once.

Which ships get the Best in Show paints?

All four ships that made it into the semi-finals of the recent Ship Showdown event (RSI Perseus, Origin M80, Drake Corsair, Drake Ironclad Assault) will receive the limited-edition Best in Show livery as well as a manufacturer-themed coin and coin case. These are available to all players with these ships in their hangars. Additionally, the Perseus will receive a collectible manufacturer-themed bomber jacket to commemorate the glory of being this year's Ship Showdown champion.

If you already have one of these ships, you'll receive the IAE-exclusive paint (and extra items) following the last day of the event at no cost. To be eligible to receive the paints, the specific Best in Show ships, and not variants, need to be active in your web-hangar at the end of IAE (having them in your Buyback List won't grant you the Best in Show paints). If you melt any of the ships before receiving the associated paints, then you will no longer be eligible.

Everyone pledging for a Best in Show (BIS) ship during the IAE will also receive the paint and items. If you don't already have the ship, it will be offered as part of a bundle with the prizes on Best in Show day.

Please note that these Best in Show Edition bundles already include the BIS paints, coin, and coin case, and will not grant the standalone versions of those items.

The Best in Show ships will also be available to fly for free between November 22 and November 27.

Will there be Warbond Daily Deals available?

Yes! Check back each day throughout the event to see what's available. Each Warbond Daily Deal will run for 24 hours only.

Will there be quantity stock-limited ships?

Yes! Each stock-limited ship is limited to one per account and will be available in six waves to cover as many global time zones as possible. Please note that depending on your time zone, some waves may occur the next calendar day.

▲ Wave 1 - 16:00 UTC

▲ Wave 2 - 20:00 UTC

▲ Wave 3 - 00:00 UTC

▲ Wave 4 - 04:00 UTC (the following day)

▲ Wave 5 - 08:00 UTC (the following day)

▲ Wave 6 - 12:00 UTC (the following day)

► Starting on November 14 (IAE Day 2): Origin 890 Jump

► Starting on November 17 (IAE Day 5): Drake Kraken, Drake Kraken Privateer

► Starting on November 18 (IAE Day 6): Consolidated Outland Pioneer

► Starting on November 20 (IAE Day 8): Aegis Idris-P, Aegis Javelin

Is there anything else that's new this IAE?

The price of the MISC Prospector will increase by $20, from $155 to $175 on MISC Day of IAE.

Until then, the Prospector will remain at $155. If you’ve been considering adding one to your fleet, there’s still time to get it before the change takes effect.

Do I need a copy of Star Citizen to enjoy the Intergalactic Aerospace Expo?

No. For the duration of the event, anyone can play Star Citizen for free. All you need to do is visit the Play Now page and follow the instructions.

Can I invite a friend?

Of course! All they need to do is visit the Play Now page, create an account, and jump into the game. Don't forget, using your referral code during account creation grants them an additional 50,000 UEC. And if they decide to stay after the Free Fly, you'll earn a referral point.

I am a new player. Where do I get more info?

The Welcome Hub is a fantastic first stop with a plethora of tips on how to get started and various tutorials to help you get off on the right foot navigating the 'verse. Star Citizen veterans act as informal guides for an ever-growing number of new players in the Guide System. The Knowledge Base answers the most frequent questions in articles that cover everything from how to create an account to character equipment.

Will there be more Twitch Drops?

Yes. Twitch Drops are returning for IAE. Watch any Drops-enabled Star Citizen stream for two hours to unlock the Venture Undersuit Black/Grey, four hours to add the matching Venture Black Armor Set, and six hours to complete the set with a MacFlex Backpack Orange.
thread_title: IAE 2956 - Choose Your Adventure - FAQ

Everyone pledging for a Best in Show (BIS) ship during the IAE will also receive the paint and items. If you don't already have the ship, it will be offered as part of a bundle with the prizes on Best in Show day.

Please note that these Best in Show Edition bundles already include the BIS paints, coin, and coin case, and will not grant the standalone versions of those items.

The Best in Show ships will also be available to fly for free between November 22 and November 27.

Will there be Warbond Daily Deals available?

Yes! Check back each day throughout the event to see what's available. Each Warbond Daily Deal will run for 24 hours only.

Will there be quantity stock-limited ships?

Yes! Each stock-limited ship is limited to one per account and will be available in six waves to cover as many global time zones as possible. Please note that depending on your time zone, some waves may occur the next calendar day.

▲ Wave 1 - 16:00 UTC

▲ Wave 2 - 20:00 UTC

▲ Wave 3 - 00:00 UTC

▲ Wave 4 - 04:00 UTC (the following day)

▲ Wave 5 - 08:00 UTC (the following day)

▲ Wave 6 - 12:00 UTC (the following day)

► Starting on November 14 (IAE Day 2): Origin 890 Jump

► Starting on November 17 (IAE Day 5): Drake Kraken, Drake Kraken Privateer

► Starting on November 18 (IAE Day 6): Consolidated Outland Pioneer

► Starting on November 20 (IAE Day 8): Aegis Idris-P, Aegis Javelin

Is there anything else that's new this IAE?

The price of the MISC Prospector will increase by $20, from $155 to $175 on MISC Day of IAE.

Until then, the Prospector will remain at $155. If you’ve been considering adding one to your fleet, there’s still time to get it before the change takes effect.

Do I need a copy of Star Citizen to enjoy the Intergalactic Aerospace Expo?

No. For the duration of the event, anyone can play Star Citizen for free. All you need to do is visit the Play Now page and follow the instructions.

Can I invite a friend?

Of course! All they need to do is visit the Play Now page, create an account, and jump into the game. Don't forget, using your referral code during account creation grants them an additional 50,000 UEC. And if they decide to stay after the Free Fly, you'll earn a referral point.

I am a new player. Where do I get more info?

The Welcome Hub is a fantastic first stop with a plethora of tips on how to get started and various tutorials to help you get off on the right foot navigating the 'verse. Star Citizen veterans act as informal guides for an ever-growing number of new players in the Guide System. The Knowledge Base answers the most frequent questions in articles that cover everything from how to create an account to character equipment.

Will there be more Twitch Drops?

Yes. Twitch Drops are returning for IAE. Watch any Drops-enabled Star Citizen stream for two hours to unlock the Venture Undersuit Black/Grey, four hours to add the matching Venture Black Armor Set, and six hours to complete the set with a MacFlex Backpack Orange.

Star Citizen Alpha 4.10.3 LIVE Release Notes

Features and Gameplay

Gameplay

Bug Fixes and Technical Updates

Alpha 4.10.3 closes 129 issues, including multiple exploits. Outside the new content the focus is on the things you touch every session: ASOP terminals and hangars, cargo and contracts, freight elevators, and the vehicle HUD.

36 of these came to us through the Issue Council, and each one carries a link to the original report. Where the cause is worth knowing, the fix carries a short note under it explaining what was going wrong and what changed. Reports filed on the Issue Council, along with the confirmations and repro steps added to existing ones, are what let us reproduce an issue reliably and rank it against everything else.

A large concentrated pass on the hangar and fleet management loop has also been done for 4.10.3 covering 14 fixes directly related to Hangar and ASOP flow.

title: Re: CIG what's the deal with the Liberator? RRR on top pads or not? It's a deal breaker for me.. can I get some clarification please?
summary: Hey everyone,
body_html:
Hey everyone,

A quick clarification regarding the Anvil Liberator:

Repair, Refuel, and Rearm (RRR): Currently in Alpha 4.10.3 the repair, refuel and rearm feature is limited to internal garages as a mitigation of current exploits, but given player feedback we are fast-tracking a potential solve in place for 5.0 that will enable RRR for all available landing pads and garages on the Liberator, as soon as possible.

Pledge Store Classification: We've also identified an issue where the Liberator is incorrectly listed as "Dropship / Dropship" on the Pledge Store. The Liberator is classified as a Light Carrier, and we're working to correct this listing as soon as possible.

Thanks for your patience, we'll keep you posted as things progress :+1:

title: Re: CIG what's the deal with the Liberator? RRR on top pads or not? It's a deal breaker for me.. can I get some clarification please?
summary: We're aware that some ships are falling off the Liberator's landing pads when they should remain attached, and we're looking into ways to address this more effectively going forward.
body_html:
We're aware that some ships are falling off the Liberator's landing pads when they should remain attached, and we're looking into ways to address this more effectively going forward.

This issue is closely related to the size of the Liberator's local grid, which was kept as small as possible to mitigate potential exploits. Some ships have their pivot, root, or origin point outside the boundaries of the Liberator's local grid when landed, preventing them from being recognized as being within that grid. The intended dimensions for each landing pad's volume are approximately 24 × 32 × 16 meters, based on the original "XS" landing pad dimensions established during the concept phase and reflected in the station metrics. The current height restriction is not intended to be a permanent limitation.

We're investigating a more robust solution to this issue, which will also be needed for the Kraken.

title: IAE 2956 - "All in a Day's Work" Video Contest
summary: The Intergalactic Aerospace Expo 2956 has landed in New Babbage! While you’re poking around the ships, we’ve been wondering what the rest of your days look like.
body_html:
The Intergalactic Aerospace Expo 2956 has landed in New Babbage! While you’re poking around the ships, we’ve been wondering what the rest of your days look like.

Some Citizens work hard for the money. Others are workin’ 9 to 5, while a few are workin’ for a livin’. There’s cargo to haul, patients to save, bounties to chase, and wrecks to salvage.

A funny thing happens when you’re busy takin’ care of business: adventure has a habit of finding you.

We want to see short videos that capture those moments, whether it’s an everyday routine or an extraordinary outcome. From heartfelt to hilarious, or harrowing to heroic, all tones welcome. Just keep it bug-free.

Been doing the same job since 3.0? Here’s your excuse to change careers for a day. Nearly everything on display in the show halls is available to test-fly for free, so now’s a good time to try something new. Your first shift as a pirate counts!

What we’re looking for:

Day-in-the-life vignettes

Dramatic reenactments of everyday events

Slice-of-life moments with an unexpected twist

New job, who dis?: your first shift in a profession you’ve never tried, and everything that goes wrong (or right)

Any profession or playstyle: miner, salvager, pirate, hauler, medic, racer, and anything else you love doing in the ’verse, whether on foot, in a ground vehicle, or in a ship

How To Participate

You picked your profession for a reason (or 10!). Showcase what you do and why you do it in a short-form video.

Please read the contest rules carefully to avoid disqualification.

:toolbox: Plan: Choose your adventure and decide what you want to show us.

:movie_camera: Capture: Record an in-game video of 60 seconds or less.

:outbox_tray: Submit: Create an IAE 2956 post on the Community Hub, submitted as a Video, with the Machinima category. Entering with a collaborator? Don’t forget to list both RSI handles!

Keep In Mind!

Read the contest rules!

Posts must be submitted to the Community Hub, as a video hosted on YouTube.

Videos must not include any third-party music, AI-edited content, effects, sounds, soundtrack, or other third-party content. Star Citizen music and sounds are accepted.

Visual post-processing effects are allowed, as well as on-screen graphics from the editing software of your choice.

Videos must not include any other video, submission, contest entry, or other external content.

Videos must include the provided end slate, shown for at least 3 seconds: https://media.robertsspaceindustries.com/qxub1wbq2zm6r/source.zip

Videos must not feature bugs, glitches, or exploits.

Maximum video/machinima length: 60 seconds, including the required end slate.

Minimum video resolution: 1920 x 1080, but 3840 x 2160 (4k UHD) is highly preferred.

Videos may have a maximum of two contributors or collaborators. You may include more players in the video, but only up to two people per submission are eligible to win.

Submissions should clearly state the RSI handles of all those being credited as contributors or collaborators at the time of submission.

Multiple submissions by or involving a participant are NOT permitted.

Replies to this thread will not count as submissions.

Preferred Tech Specs:

VIDEO

Format: .MP4

Codec: H.264

Aspect Ratio: 16:9

Frame Rate: 30fps (minimum)

Pixel Dimensions:

3840 x 2160 4k UHD (preferred) / 1920 x 1080 (minimum)

AUDIO

Stereo, 48kHz, 24bit (16bit minimum)

Winning Conditions

The CIG jury will judge your submissions on the following:

Rule adherence

Creativity

Quality

Humor / Entertainment factor

Dates

The submission period ends on Friday, November 27, 2026, 20:00 UTC.

Rewards

Up to two credited contributors or collaborators per winning entry will each receive:

:first_place_medal: 1st Place: RSI Galaxy in-game standalone ship with LTI (in-game lifetime insurance) and a set of Cargo & Medical Modules

:second_place_medal: 2nd Place: Origin M80 in-game standalone ship with LTI (in-game lifetime insurance)

:third_place_medal: 3rd Place: GATAC Hyun in-game standalone ship with LTI (in-game lifetime insurance)

Now, let’s get to work, work, work, work, work, work! :muscle:
